thread.title: Cheatham Hill Elementary families now have new online option for cafeteria payments
thread.title_full: Cheatham Hill Elementary families now have new online option for cafeteria payments

author: Cobb Reporter
title: Cheatham Hill Elementary families now have new online option for cafeteria payments
text:
Chris Ragsdale Superintendent | Cobb County School District
Chris Ragsdale Superintendent | Cobb County School District
Cobb County School District (CCSD) has announced the introduction of MySchoolBucks, a new online system for making cafeteria payments. The service allows parents and guardians to set up an account using a major credit card and add funds for their child’s school meals.
To use the service, families will need each student’s CCSD Student ID number. Employees can use their EID. MySchoolBucks is now the platform for all cafeteria account payments, while MyPaymentsPlus will continue to be used for other school fees and activities.
With MySchoolBucks, users can check meal account balances, review purchase and payment history, and receive email alerts when funds are low. There is a $2.49 fee per payment that covers multiple students and up to $200 per transaction. According to CCSD, "Cobb County School District does not receive any part of this fee."
For assistance with the new system, families can visit the MSB frequently asked questions page, use live chat on the MySchoolBucks website, or call 1-855-832-5226 for support. More information about meal payment options is available from CCSD Food and Nutrition Services at https://www.cobbk12.org/page/453/food-nutrition-services.
